interpretation: No added radial angular mean is required in these fixed-C low-order models after free coherent V and constant angular field. This does not exclude static anisotropy or establish physical isotropy.
resolution: J3 nulls are properties of this 36-row compression and mean family, not an intrinsic limit of the original CF4 catalogue.
interval_scope: Conservative supports of a common rank-r confidence region, not sharp profile-likelihood bounds; domain-certification failure does not by itself prove the exact nonlinear image unbounded.

cache_reuse.reuse_policy: Pinned input/code/cache identity plus mandatory seven-model numerical parity; no pair-sum or cache write.
cache_reuse.compatibility_helper_note: R58 compatibility helper uses g for all rows; original unused lin block uses1+z. Correct full-stack fingerprint is recorded separately; selected rows are all log-eta rows.

augmentation.parameter_count_convention: Field/velocity rank counts coherent V3 plus 9*(J+1) signed distance-field coefficients; extra method-angular nuisance rank is reported separately.
augmentation.scientific_result: All selected68/72row augmentations restore rank39 for the J3 distance-field plus coherent-V3 family, including profiling24method-angular nuisance directions in the68row cases. This removes the initial structural compression null, but does not ensure precise derivative images or empirical calibration.

decision: Consolidate P3 around source-dependent radial information and resolution recovery. Use initial36 and augmented68/72 contrasts jointly in the manuscript; do not claim intrinsic CF4 derivative impossibility or general physical anisotropy detection.
